mapper.select: select type, status, handler, start_time as startTime, end_time as endTime, editor, server_id as serverId from fulltextindex_rebuild_audit where type = #{type} and handler = #{handler}
mapper.update: update fulltextindex_rebuild_audit set status = 'done' where status = 'doing'
mapper.insert: insert into fulltextindex_rebuild_audit (type, status, handler, start_time, editor, server_id) values (#{type}, #{status}, #{handler}, now(3), #{editor}, #{serverId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `start_time` = now(3), `status` = #{status}, `end_time` = null, `server_id` = #{serverId}, `editor` = #{editor}, `error` = null
